ValidationRule.description: Make fields mandatory to input value for anticipated termination date and reason for termination
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND($Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.NSP_AssetValidations__c!=True, OR( AND( NSP_Verbal_Term_recd__c=TRUE, OR( ISBLANK( NSP_Verbal_Term_Date__c ) )), AND( NSP_Written_Term_recd__c =TRUE, OR( ISBLANK( NSP_Written_Term_Date__c ), ISBLANK( NSP_Anticipated_Date_Of_Termination__c ), ISBLANK( NSP_Reason_for_Term__c ) )) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Anticipated Date of Termination and reason for termination is mandatory
